past.employee_description:
I was a co-founder of Relbit and responsible for team of 10 people developing, marketing and operating the system & platform.

Relbit was s startup building a PaaS (Platform-as-a-service) system for simple deployment and operations of PHP and MySQL web applications with automatic infinite scaling options. 

Relbit offered both on-prem system with easy installation & online hosted version.

The on-prem system was a custom built operating system based on Scientific Linux / CentOS with easy installation, clustering, management, upgrade options etc. The system utilised OpenVZ containers and ZFS storage. 

The online offering allowed customers to have easy web-hosting like experience was large applications. 

Customers included SME.sk, QualityUnit (LiveAgent & PostAffiliatePro), BiznisWeb.sk and others. 

The company raised angel/seed investment in 2010, joined StartupSauna 2014 in Helsinki and was closed in the beginning of 2015.
